items: The director will speak ____ about the reorganization before taking questions.
'Briefly' is the adverb meaning for a short time or in few words.
The factory experienced a temporary parts ____ after one supplier suspended production.
A 'shortage' is a situation in which there is not enough of something.
The new employee will begin work ____ after completing the required safety orientation.
The supervisor asked the team to ____ the cause of the repeated equipment failures.
'Determine' means establish or find out something through investigation.
The committee will ____ whether to approve the proposed office relocation next week.
'Decide whether' means make a choice after consideration.
The maintenance engineer was able to ____ the network problem within an hour.
'Solve' means find an answer to a problem.
The two companies reached an agreement to ____ the billing dispute without going to court.
'Settle a dispute' means resolve it by agreement.
The manager asked each department to ____ its spending for the next quarter.
'Estimate' means make an approximate calculation or judgment of an amount.
The company plans to ____ a new regional office in Sendai next year.
'Establish' means set up an organization, office, or system.
We cannot ____ that every customer has read the revised terms.
'Assume' means accept something as true without proof.
The new packaging is designed to ____ less plastic than the previous version.
Production will ____ on Monday after the electrical inspection is completed.
'Resume' means begin again after a pause.
The revised timetable is intended to ____ delays during the morning rush.
'Reduce' means make something smaller in amount or degree.
The analysis allowed the team to ____ that demand would remain strong through the summer.
'Deduce' means reach a conclusion by reasoning from available information.
The factory can ____ up to 2,000 units per day at full capacity.
The company will ____ a survey to measure employee satisfaction after the reorganization.
'Conduct' means carry out an activity such as a survey.
Payroll will ____ the cost of optional parking permits from employees' monthly salaries.
'Deduct' means subtract an amount from a total or payment.
All visitors must be ____ by an employee while inside the research facility.
'Accompanied' means going together with another person.
The engineering team ____ the installation ahead of schedule despite several delivery delays.
'Accomplished' means successfully completed or achieved something.
The finance manager asked that every expense be properly ____ for before the audit.
New employees quickly become ____ to the company's flexible scheduling system.
'Accustomed to' means familiar with something through experience.
The company plans to ____ a new customer-feedback platform in September.
'Launch' means introduce or start a new product, service, or initiative.
The contract is ____ for renewal at the end of the fiscal year.
'Due for' means expected or scheduled to happen.
The sales figures remained ____ throughout the first half of the year.
The office manager ordered additional ____ for the new employees' desks.
'Stationery' means writing and office supplies such as paper and envelopes.
